raw_posts.name: Articos MCP
raw_posts.tagline: See how simulated buyers react, right in your agent
raw_posts.description: Most teams ship, then hope it lands. Articos MCP lets you check first. Right inside Claude or ChatGPT, run your headlines, positioning, or pages past simulated buyers based on your actual customers, and see how they respond before it goes out. Validated against human research from Baymard and Nielsen Norman, it agrees 86% of the time.

raw_posts.name: OpenCode 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: The open source AI coding agent
raw_posts.description: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent. It’s available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or web app.

raw_posts.name: Fina Business
raw_posts.tagline: The flexible $20/mo QuickBooks alternative for founders
raw_posts.description: You started a business, not an accounting department. Fina Business gives founders the essentials of business accounting without the complexity of traditional tools. Track business and personal finances your way, automate invoices, accept Stripe payments, manage customers, and get double-entry bookkeeping, P&L, and balance sheets. Start at $20/mo and customize Fina around how your business actually works.

raw_posts.name: Muse Wonder
raw_posts.tagline: Meta’s most capable models for personal agents
raw_posts.description: Muse Wonder is Meta’s new model series for personal and professional agents, with two models: Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Active Memory carries your context across conversations, Active Focus keeps working through blockers on hard goals, and it adds domain expertise in law, finance, and health plus stronger coding. Muse Wonder is live on the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers.

raw_posts.name: Kai
raw_posts.tagline: Autonomous assistant designed to handle meetings and email
raw_posts.description: Kai is an AI executive assistant for solopreneurs, freelancers and startup founders. It works across your email, calendar and tasks: it triages your inbox and drafts replies, schedules around your availability, records and transcribes your meetings, then turns them into summaries and action items. Workflows run in the background, and Kai hands tasks to Claude or ChatGPT with the context of the meeting or email they came from. Web, desktop and mobile. Product Hunt sign-ups get 2x trial credits.

raw_posts.name: MentionBird
raw_posts.description: We took the top 3 Product Hunt launches and asked ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude the exact questions their buyers ask: “Best browser for Claude Code?” “How do I track agent run costs?” “Best open-source Grok alternative?” Nine answers. Zero mentions. AI sent their buyers elsewhere. That’s how AI search works. It pulls from pages it trusts—listicles, Reddit, comparisons, YouTube. If you’re not there, you’re not in the answer. MentionBird helps you fix that.

raw_posts.name: MausBot
raw_posts.tagline: Open source Grok Bot: Free, Local
raw_posts.description: Give each bot a job and work with it in a familiar chat interface. MausBot brings your supported AI agents together on your computer, with tools and routines for getting work done. Free and open source under Apache 2.0. Bring your own provider account or API key; provider fees and limits apply.

raw_posts.name: Takes for Mac
raw_posts.tagline: Record talking-head videos. Claude Code does the edit.
raw_posts.description: A free, open-source Mac app for talking-head videos. A teleprompter that follows your voice, one-button recording of camera and screen, and every take in plain folders. Claude Code, on your own Claude plan, cuts the edit, makes the vertical version and drafts the posts. Leave notes on the frame; it turns them into rules and remembers them.

raw_posts.name: PostNitro for Agents
raw_posts.tagline: Let your AI agent design and publish social posts
raw_posts.description: Most social APIs let an agent publish text or media it already has. PostNitro lets it design the post too. Connect from Claude or ChatGPT in one click (OAuth, no API key), or use our 35-tool MCP server, CLI or REST API. Your agent turns a topic, article or X thread into an on-brand carousel, image post or animated video, then schedules it to LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Facebook and Pinterest. Or it hands you an editable draft to finish.

raw_posts.name: Toby
raw_posts.tagline: Realistic mock interviews with an AI hiring manager
raw_posts.description: Paste a job description. Toby researches the company, maps every round and interviews you on a Meet, Teams or Zoom-style call. Then you get a scored debrief and a stronger version of each answer, built only from what you said. Real mode runs it straight through; Coach mode gives a note and a retry. No subscription: 50p a minute on a call. First 5 minutes free.
